description: Path A threshold fixture. churn_rate is the only bounded variable (max 0.5); its initial value sits right on 0.9*max = 0.45. State-jitter perturbation straddles that boundary, so detect_regime flips some runs to FRAGILE and leaves others NORMAL => a genuinely bimodal regime distribution, with NO change to engine code. The negative churn->mrr and churn->system_stability links carry the consequence. NOTE: linear propagation only moves a variable when something injects a delta into it; a *catastrophic* (bimodal goal_score) failure needs the non-linear rule from Path B (core/threshold_rules.py). Engine schema: initial_state for values, variable_specs for bounds, from/to+polarity/strength for links, objectives as a dict.
